summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Chris Snell, a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman who later worked as an amateur scout. It gives his birth date and place and his 1991 NHL draft selection by the Buffalo Sabres. It also notes his current role as an Ontario Hockey League amateur scout for the Winnipeg Jets.
one_line: Chris Snell is a former Canadian pro hockey defenceman turned Winnipeg Jets amateur scout, drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in 1991.
key_facts: Chris Snell was born on May 12, 1971 in Regina, Saskatchewan.
Chris Snell is a former professional ice hockey defenceman.
Chris Snell works as an amateur scout (Ontario Hockey League) for the Winnipeg Jets.
Chris Snell was drafted in the seventh round, 145th overall, in the 1991 NHL Entry Draft.
The Buffalo Sabres drafted Chris Snell in the 1991 NHL Entry Draft.
Chris Snell was selected 145th overall, which was in the seventh round of the draft.
